questions.q: Which document defines the authority and scope of an audit engagement?
questions.explain: The audit charter defines authority, scope, responsibilities, and report recipients.

questions.q: Which techniques belong to audit data collection? (Select all that apply)
questions.explain: Sampling, questionnaires, and interviews are data collection techniques. Loss of license is a non-compliance consequence (5.4).

questions.q: Which type of test provides the tester with all internal information about the system?
questions.explain: Known-environment testing provides architecture, source code, and access; it is more targeted and faster.

questions.q: Which reconnaissance does not interact with the target and leaves no trace in its logs?
questions.explain: Passive reconnaissance uses public sources without contacting the target; active reconnaissance generates traces.

questions.q: Match each framework to its central question.

pairs.right: Which phase of the intrusion is the attack in?
Which technique is the adversary using?
Who is attacking whom, with what, and from where?

questions.explain: Kill Chain = phases, ATT&CK = techniques, Diamond Model = relationship among four elements.

questions.q: How many tactics are in the current version of the MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise matrix?
questions.explain: The Enterprise matrix has 14 tactics. The table in the 11 Strategies book shows 11: that is an older version that should not be reproduced.
